links.outcome: LLM veracity classification and error localization on Chinese medical fact-checking benchmark
links.effect: Models often determine if text contains errors but struggle to localize them precisely; top performers fall short of human performance; over-criticism misidentifies correct information as erroneous.
links.quote: We evaluate 20 leading LLMs on veracity classification and error localization, and results show models often determine if text contains errors but struggle to localize them precisely, with top performers falling short of human performance.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an automated benchmark (MedFact) testing the medical fact-checking and error-localization capabilities of 20 LLMs across Chinese medical texts.
